description: DDL-first table migration: build portable CREATE TABLE statements from source INFORMATION_SCHEMA (types + PKs + FKs + NOT NULL + defaults) and execute on target. Emits per-table status DataFrame.

inputs.description: Reads source INFORMATION_SCHEMA for column + constraint metadata

outputs.description: Per-table status: schema_name, table_name, target_table, status, error_message, n_columns, n_foreign_keys, has_primary_key, ddl_preview

source_connection_env_var.description: Env var with source SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR source_connection.
source_connection_env_var.label: Source Connection Env Var

target_connection_env_var.description: Env var with target SQLAlchemy URL. Set this OR target_connection.
target_connection_env_var.label: Target Connection Env Var

schemas.description: Source schemas to scan (default: all non-system)
schemas.label: Source Schemas

include_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns (case-insensitive) against qualified table names. Examples: ['HR.*'], ['HR.EMPLOYEES', 'FINANCE.STG_*']. Default: include all discovered tables.
include_patterns.label: Include Patterns

exclude_patterns.description: fnmatch-style glob patterns to exclude. Applied AFTER include_patterns. Examples: ['*_TEMP', '*.BKP_*', 'HR.AUDIT_*'].
exclude_patterns.label: Exclude Patterns

target_schema.description: Override target schema (e.g. 'RAW' → all tables land in RAW.<name>). Default: keep source schema name.
target_schema.label: Target Schema Override

table_replacements.description: FK reference rewrites (old qualified name → new). Used when foreign keys point at tables that landed in different schemas on target.
table_replacements.label: FK Table Replacements

table_ddl_overrides.label: Per-Table CREATE TABLE Overrides
table_ddl_overrides.description: Source qualified name → full CREATE TABLE SQL on target. Used for tables the auto-generator can't handle (XMLTYPE, etc.)

drop_if_exists.description: If true, DROP TABLE IF EXISTS on target before CREATE. Default: false (CREATE will fail if it already exists, which is safer for incremental re-runs).
drop_if_exists.label: Drop If Exists

include_primary_keys.description: Include PK constraint in CREATE TABLE.
include_primary_keys.label: Include Primary Keys

include_foreign_keys.description: Include FK constraints in CREATE TABLE. Set false to migrate types + PKs only.
include_foreign_keys.label: Include Foreign Keys

include_check_constraints.description: Include CHECK constraints. Dialect-specific functions in CHECK expressions can fail on target — use function_replacements or table_ddl_overrides.
include_check_constraints.label: Include CHECK Constraints

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Try every CREATE TABLE in a transaction then ROLLBACK — no state change. Status: would_succeed / would_fail.

fail_on_any_error.description: If true, asset materialization fails when any table fails. Default: report in status DataFrame and succeed.
fail_on_any_error.label: Fail On Any Error

name: Database Tables Migration
